actualExperiment.prompt: Create a colorful 3D obstacle course where a small robot must jump over moving platforms, collect glowing coins, and reach a finish portal. Make it playful, visually appealing, and easy to understand.
actualExperiment.implementation: experiments/robot-run/index.html and game.js authored by this Codex assistant in this session, with iterative fixes
actualExperiment.recording: Real local browser; brief display and source inspection are labeled, with no fake AI generation progress
actualExperiment.inputs: Playwright W key held; browser keyboard events press Space at platform edges; no teleport or state mutation
actualExperiment.freeTier: No free-tier claim for Codex. Existing session used; no additional purchase.
actualExperiment.assets: Original procedural meshes, colors and lighting; no borrowed creator game.
